- **High damping level** – Reduces impacts and vibration that cause hand fatigue and pain
- **Ribbed palm design** – The ribs conform to your hands and reduce torsional forces, providing comfort where you need it most
- **Thicker profile** (33.5mm diameter vs. 30mm on the Ruffian) – More cushioning to absorb trail chatter
- **Ergonomic advantage** – Designed for "vibration/torque reduction; comfort"

The Reflex maintains aggressive finger traction so you won't sacrifice control, but the softer palm side and vibration-damping properties should significantly reduce the hand pain you're experiencing on your weekend rides.
